one_liner: Cloud-based phone system and call center software with AI conversation intelligence and APIs.
auth_notes: Aircall supports both Basic Authentication (API ID and token) for private internal tools and OAuth for multi-user integrations.
access_notes: Users can sign up for a customer account or trial, giving access to the developer dashboard to generate API keys.
api_notes: Covers calls, contacts, users, webhooks, and AI voice agent features via REST endpoints and webhooks.
blocker_notes: Public APIs and self-serve credentials are fully available.

auth.quote: Aircall supports two ways to authenticate with the REST API: Basic Authentication and OAuth.

access.quote: You must have an Aircall account. Sign up as a customer here or if you qualify to be a tech partner you can then sign up for a developer account here.

api.quote: Use our REST API and webhooks to access calls, contacts, and users — and keep every system in sync with what's happening on every call, human or AI.

mcp.quote: Connect your tools and data to Aircall's AI Virtual Agents through MCP. Handle inbound and outbound calls.

verdict.quote: Extend your own setup, Connect your CRM, automate workflows, or build custom integrations for your own Aircall workspace, no marketplace approval needed.
